name: BigEarthNet-S2
tagline: Multi-label land cover from Sentinel-2, 19 classes
modality: Sentinel-2 L2A · RGB · 10 m · 120×120 px · 10% subset
description: Multi-label land-cover classification on reBEN, the 2024 BigEarthNet v2.0 release: Sentinel-2 patches from ten European countries labelled from CORINE Land Cover with the 19-class nomenclature, about three labels per patch. The hub uses a seeded 10% subset of each official split, streamed from the 63 GB archive (RGB bands, reflectance clipped at 2,750 → 8-bit). The official split is geographic — train and test patches come from different regions — and the official test sample is halved into public and hidden halves. Primary metric is macro mAP: rare labels such as beaches or coastal wetlands weigh as much as arable land. Two labels (coastal wetlands, beaches) have fewer than 20 hidden positives; their AP is reported per class but excluded from the macro average, where a single patch could swing the score. Not comparable to full-dataset multispectral results.
citation: Clasen, Hackel, Burgert, Sumbul, Demir, Markl. reBEN: Refined BigEarthNet Dataset for Remote Sensing Image Analysis. arXiv:2407.03653, 2024; Sumbul et al. BigEarthNet, IGARSS 2019.
classes: Land principally occupied by agriculture, with significant areas of natural vegetation
Natural grassland and sparsely vegetated areas
